notes: WeWork's seven San Francisco workspaces, named in issue #323, read from each building page on 2026-09-12. https://www.wework.com/l/coworking-space/san-francisco--sf-bay-area--CA names seven locations and links a building page for each; the building page carries the address in a schema.org PostalAddress. Two reads on 2026-09-12 agreed on every address and every hours block. The list names three of the seven by their building's name rather than a number (Salesforce Tower, Two Embarcadero Center, 44 Montgomery); the street address is the building page's own. **No hours are published**: what each page gives is 'Staffed hours', Mon-Fri 8am-5pm at all seven, which is when the front desk is manned and not when a member can get in — publishing it as `opening_hours` would have the panel print every WeWork closed at the weekend. It is recorded in `extra` and stays off the page, so the entries carry no 'Last updated' line. The issue's JSON also gives a rating and a starting price per location; neither is a fact about the building and both are left out, as Bites' `priceRange` was. One link covers all seven — refer.wework.com/i/nolastan, which opens WeWork's own referral page offering 'One month free on a 12-month commitment', the issue's wording confirmed on the page itself — so there is one REFERRALS row, `wework`, and one source id for all seven pages.

coverage.remaining: None; every San Francisco location WeWork lists is here.

citation.label: WeWork, Two Embarcadero Center building page
citation.locator: the page's schema.org PostalAddress and its staffed-hours block

resolution.method: By hand: sf-eas-addresses has no street named EMBARCADERO CENTER at all — the registry spells the waterfront street THE EMBARCADERO and holds no 2 THE EMBARCADERO either, filing parcel 0231023 under 201 CLAY ST, which sf-parcels confirms today: blklot 0231023 is active with mapblklot 0231023, 201–201 CLAY, in Financial District/South Beach — one parcel, not a condominium stack. The 2025 roll names it '0000 0002 THE EMBARCADERO', commercial office, built 1974, 35 stories. The FITNESS SF run of 2026-09-11 resolved the same address to the same parcel and the site's page for it is /san-francisco/financial-district/embarcadero-center/2/, so the WeWork workspace goes there.
